notes: 「纸」在图鉴中已有独立条目（蔡伦叙事），本条目把笔墨纸砚作为文房成套工具，重点写墨与砚，并与纸条目交叉引用而不重复四大发明纸故事。
notes_en: Paper already has its own atlas entry (Cai Lun narrative). This item treats brush, inkstick, paper and inkstone as one scholarly set, emphasizing inkstick and inkstone and cross-referencing paper without retelling the Four Great Inventions paper story.
summary_zh: 笔、墨、纸、砚合称文房四宝。汉代已有笔墨砚组合；北宋《文房四谱》（986）将其作为成套名物。纸的发明见「纸」条目。
summary_en: Brush, inkstick, paper and inkstone form China’s Four Treasures of the Study. A Han toolkit is early; the Song Wenfang sipu (986) names the set. For papermaking see the separate Paper entry.
